function.name: yuvomi_mcp__add_shopping_item
function.description: Use current Yuvomi shopping state including checked items. Preserve existing names and categories. For every NEW item supply the best fitting category on the FIRST call from list_shopping_categories (unless known from context), never invent names and use Sonstiges only if no specific category fits; category_required returns valid names for a corrected call, with no writes. Never equate partial names, brands or size variants. Open products are updated on their existing ID, never duplicated. ensure and increase both add quantities for open items; if addition is unsafe, replace with the requested free text and clearly report replacement without a question. Missing quantity means 1 (one current unit when identifiable). Checked items reactivate with the requested quantity. Use set only for an explicit absolute correction. Report old_quantity, new_quantity and action; replayed means already processed, do not claim another addition. Optional note preserves existing text by default (append); note_mode=replace/clear only on explicit request. For pure note edits use operation=note, never ensure/increase: no quantity addition or reactivation. Never report not_executed or execution_unconfirmed as success or blindly retry uncertain writes.

name.description: Exact requested product/brand name. Never shorten, substitute brands or use synonyms.

quantity.description: Free text quantity, e.g. 2 Packungen or 2 Tuben. Omitted means 1. For open items ensure and increase both add compatible quantities; otherwise replace with this value and report it. Checked items reactivate with this new quantity, never add to the old one. set is an explicit absolute correction.

category.description: For EVERY NEW product choose the best matching exact existing Yuvomi category and supply it on the FIRST call. Read list_shopping_categories first unless valid names are already in context. Never invent categories. Choose Sonstiges only when no specific existing category fits. Existing items always keep their Yuvomi category.

operation.description: ensure/increase: add to open items or replace incompatible/unparseable quantities, create new or reactivate checked items. Missing quantity defaults to 1. set: explicit absolute correction only; quantity required. note: edit ONLY an existing item note, without quantity/category/status changes; never use ensure for a note-only request.

note.description: Optional shopping note. Omit to preserve existing notes, including reactivation. With existing text default append; replace only when explicitly requested. Unicode/newlines supported.

note_mode.description: Default append. replace explicitly replaces; clear explicitly deletes without a note field. For note-only edits use operation=note (no quantity or category).

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__create_task
function.description: Create a new task on the family planner.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags. Unlike the single category, a task can carry many. Mirrored to CATEGORIES on CalDAV task lists.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_shopping_categories
function.description: Read all existing Yuvomi shopping category names via REST. Use only these categories when categorizing items.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_shopping_items
function.description: List shopping items across all lists (unchecked by default).

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_tasks
function.description: List the family's current top-level tasks (open by default). Optionally filter by status and tags. Each task carries its tags; tags are free-form labels mirrored from CalDAV task lists and are distinct from the single category a task has.

status.description: Filter by task status. "archived" is not a status but the separate archive: it lists the filed-away tasks with whatever status they carry.

include_future.description: Include tasks that only start at a later date. Left out by default, matching the app: a task with a start date next week is not up yet.

tag.description: Filter by tags. Several tags narrow the list (a task must carry all of them). Case-insensitive.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__list_upcoming_events
function.description: List upcoming calendar events from today onward.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__suggest_shopping_items
function.description: Read Yuvomi shopping suggestions for q (prefix search). Only an exactly matching normalized name may supply a previous category. Similar names are different products. Never copy historical quantities automatically.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__add_shopping_item
function.description: Add to one list using current Yuvomi state. Preserve exact products and existing categories. Supply a valid category on the first call for every new item. Open items add compatible quantities, otherwise replace transparently; checked items reactivate with new quantity. Use operation=note for note-only edits. Report actual outcomes; never retry uncertain writes.

name.description: Exact product/brand; no synonyms, partial matches or substitution.

quantity.description: Free text (e.g. 2 Tuben). Omitted: +1 current unit if known for open items, otherwise 1. Open: add compatible amounts, otherwise replace. Checked: set new quantity. set is absolute.

category.description: NEW items: exact valid category on first call; read categories unless known. Never invent one; Sonstiges only if none fits. Existing category wins.

operation.description: ensure/increase: add or transparently replace unsafe amounts, create/reactivate. set: absolute; quantity required. note: existing note only, no quantity/category or status change.

note.description: Optional Unicode note; omit to preserve, even on reactivation. Default append; replace only explicitly.

note_mode.description: append default; replace/clear only explicitly. clear without note. Note-only: operation=note, no quantity/category.

function.name: yuvomi_mcp__add_shopping_items
function.description: Process 1–20 items on one list; category belongs in each new items[] object. Add to one list using current Yuvomi state. Preserve exact products and existing categories. Supply a valid category on the first call for every new item. Open items add compatible quantities, otherwise replace transparently; checked items reactivate with new quantity. Use operation=note for note-only edits. Report actual outcomes; never retry uncertain writes.

name.description: Exact product/brand; no synonyms, partial matches or substitution.

category.description: NEW items: exact valid category on first call; read categories unless known. Never invent one; Sonstiges only if none fits. Existing category wins.

operation.description: ensure/increase: add or transparently replace unsafe amounts, create/reactivate. set: absolute; quantity required. note: existing note only, no quantity/category or status change.

note.description: Optional Unicode note; omit to preserve, even on reactivation. Default append; replace only explicitly.

note_mode.description: append default; replace/clear only explicitly. clear without note. Note-only: operation=note, no quantity/category.
